title: Read System settings' sections and the Usage charts in mounted cases

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** At `8a18711cbc5c585481913cc47b92de41f505518b`, the mounted Add Project case catches project arrow shortcuts escaping an open dialog. This checks the Cancel and Escape example in `SEED-413#mount-system-settings-sections-and-usage-charts`, as specified in plan 749.

The focused Chromium case `Cancel and Escape save nothing, return focus and keep project arrows inside the modal` mounts the production project keyboard hook with Open Dough and Pygardon. In the detached scratch checkout, the case passed. The only fault was removing the `isInsideOpenDialog(event.target)` refusal in `dashboard/src/projectKeyboardNavigation.ts:112`. During the faulted run, with focus on Cancel and the dialog still open, ArrowRight and ArrowLeft invoked the project selection callback for Pygardon and Open Dough in that order. The recorded calls show that both keys reached project navigation. The maintained no-call assertion at `dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/project-add-dialog.spec.ts:75` failed on those two calls. This verdict covers the open-dialog arrow sequence through the mounted keyboard handler.

All three runs used the same focused command with two workers and selected just this case. After restoring the source byte for byte, the restored run passed and the detached checkout matched its clean pre-probe state. The scratch checkout was retired.

**Next proof action.** Keep the current mounted assertion for this path.

- **Test runtime.** 8.34 s measured by Vitest across the baseline, faulted, and restored runs, respectively 3.22 s, 2.14 s, and 2.98 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human effort measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active agent effort measurement was recorded.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 107281 ms (measured), from 1795239353161 to 1795239460442 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
